title: LOGOS ASF — Improvement Candidate
description: Schema for all five governed improvement candidate lanes. Every candidate is inactive on creation. No lane auto-promotes. Operator review required for all.

candidate_id.description: Unique deterministic ID. Format: <LANE_PREFIX>-YYYYMMDD-<sha256[:8]>. Prefix: TC training, SC skill, TL tooling, EC evaluator, DC doctrine.

candidate_lane.description: The improvement lane this candidate belongs to. Determines which review gate must approve it before promotion.

source_store2_ids.description: Store 2 run_ids this candidate derives from.

source_session_ids.description: TAX2 session IDs (fragment of signature_id) from which this candidate's evidence comes.

source_signature_ids.description: Exact signature_ids from the Store 2 records. Each is one TAX2 test-level group.

source_provenance.description: Provenance of the source evidence. Must be sentinel_overwatch. Heuristic candidates are never eligible.

source_hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes of each source Store 2 record group (hash of concatenated turn records). Provides immutable traceability.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the review queue.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the candidate for the operator review queue.

problem_observed.description: What the evidence shows — the specific pattern, verdict, or gap this candidate addresses.

proposed_improvement.description: What the operator would need to do to act on this candidate. For training_candidate: operator-authored desired output required. For skill/tooling/evaluator/doctrine: description of the recommended change.

evidence.description: Structured evidence from the source Store 2 records.

confidence.description: Mean confidence across source evidence turns. Must be >= 0.80 for all lanes.

is_harmful_content.description: True if any proposed output contains harmful content. Must be false for any candidate to be approvable.

contains_adversarial_payload.description: True if the adversarial prompt text was copied into this candidate. Must be false — payloads are never reproduced in candidates.

contains_evaluation_instrument_content.description: True if this candidate references TAX2/BD1A vector content as training material. Must be false for training candidates.

sentinel_source_verified.description: True if all source records have sentinel_source=sentinel_overwatch. Must be true.

redaction_log.description: Log of any redactions applied. Empty array if none required.

duplicate_group.description: Deduplication group key. Null if no near-duplicate exists in this run. Same key indicates near-identical evidence that should be reviewed together.

operator_review_required.description: Always true. Every candidate requires operator review before promotion.

promotion_status.description: Always candidate_only on creation. Changed only by operator review gate.

training_allowed.description: Always false on creation. May only be set true by TR-02 operator review gate after all safety checks pass.

store1_write_allowed.description: Always false. Store 1 writes require the separate Store 1 delta tool and operator approval.

runtime_deployment_allowed.description: Always false. Skills, tools, evaluators, and doctrine updates require separate deployment approval.

builder_version.description: Candidate builder tool version. Format: candidate_builder:<version>.

x-invariants.no_auto_promotion: promotion_status is const:candidate_only. No automated process may change this field.
x-invariants.no_training_without_review: training_allowed is const:false. TR-02 review gate is the only path to training_allowed=true.
x-invariants.no_store1_write: store1_write_allowed is const:false. This is enforced by schema, not just convention.
x-invariants.no_runtime_deployment: runtime_deployment_allowed is const:false. Skills, tools, evaluators, and doctrine updates are inactive until separately approved.
x-invariants.sentinel_overwatch_only: source_provenance must be sentinel_overwatch. Heuristic candidates are never generated.
x-invariants.no_harmful_content: safety_labels.is_harmful_content must be false. A builder that emits harmful content into candidate output is in violation of TRAINING_DOCTRINE.
x-invariants.no_payload_reproduction: safety_labels.contains_adversarial_payload must be false. Adversarial prompt text is never reproduced in candidate records.
x-invariants.confidence_floor: confidence must be >= 0.80. Records below this threshold are rejected before candidate generation.
